title: Set of 3
text:
Set of 3. My wife is a great baker and our old pans were pretty banged up. Plus as my daughter moves out she will inherit the old pans.
We really like the pans especially have the silicone insert. Baking cookies, bread and a few other items as resulted in easier clean up and less mess. So far these pans haven't warped like the others did in the past.

product_metadata.title: Artisan 2-Piece Professional Baking Set with Quarter-Size Cookie Sheet Pan and Silicone Baking Mat with Red Border
